title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
hook_text: Meta can scrape your site for free
script:
Meta will start training its AI models on your website content for free.
New business terms taking effect on October 30th grant this broad permission.
The update applies to any websites associated with businesses that use Meta platforms.
Meta can crawl and scrape this external content to develop and research new software.
This shift follows previous industry standard practices where publishers could opt out of training.
It means your articles or images could power Meta AI without direct compensation or consent.
Would you block your site from these crawlers?
